svg.title: Two ways into the MCP server built into Bytebase
svg.desc: A client can connect straight to the MCP server in Bytebase, or run the Bytebase MCP package locally, which forwards to the same server. Approval, access control, masking and audit happen in Bytebase, in front of the databases.
svg.text: Two ways into the MCP server built into Bytebase
